title: Revit Template Content Manifest Fields

entries.name: Template identity
entries.requirement: Each governed Revit template release shall have a stable identity distinct from ad-hoc project copies.

entries.name: Template scope
entries.requirement: The release shall declare its office/base, discipline, regional or other bounded applicability where relevant.

entries.name: Supported Revit version
entries.requirement: The release shall declare the supported Revit version or compatibility basis.

entries.name: Template release version
entries.requirement: The release shall have a governed version or release identifier sufficient for project traceability and change control.

entries.name: Required view-template content
entries.requirement: The manifest shall identify required governed view templates or references to the applicable view-template registry.

entries.name: Required annotation content
entries.requirement: The manifest shall identify required governed text, dimension, tag, symbol or keynote content where applicable.

entries.name: Required graphics content
entries.requirement: The manifest shall identify required Object Styles, line styles, filters or other governed graphics content where applicable.

entries.name: Required titleblock content
entries.requirement: The manifest shall identify the governed titleblock families or references required for the template scope.

entries.name: Required material content
entries.requirement: Where materials are part of the template baseline, the manifest shall identify the governed material set or reference its registry.

entries.name: Phase configuration
entries.requirement: Where phase configuration is part of the template baseline, the manifest shall identify the required governed phases and phase-filter basis.

entries.name: Worksharing content
entries.requirement: Where worksets or worksharing settings are preconfigured, the manifest shall identify the applicable governed worksharing basis.

entries.name: Governed parameter content
entries.requirement: The manifest shall identify required governed project/shared parameters or reference the applicable parameter registry.

entries.name: Release notes and impact
entries.requirement: Each governed release shall record material changes, compatibility or migration impacts, and known limitations.

entries.name: Deprecation status
entries.requirement: Superseded template releases shall be identifiable as deprecated or retired rather than remaining indistinguishable from current approved releases.

non_promoted_source_content: Source filename patterns containing organization placeholders are not promoted as canonical naming rules.
The source discipline-template catalogue is treated as an illustrative scope list until each template is approved and registered.
Placeholder repository paths, owners, titleblock names, view-template IDs, phase values and shared-parameter values remain unresolved.

provenance.source_title: Revit Project Templates – Instructions, Definitions, Workflows
provenance.migration_note: Migrated the content-manifest and release-control fields needed to make template validation executable without promoting placeholder template names or incomplete catalogue values.
